DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日はどのようなご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to discuss today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 制度の説明を詳しく聞きたいです。日本語だけだと理解し切れないと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 日本語だけでは長い制度相談が難しいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to hear a detailed explanation of the program. I don't think I can fully understand it in Japanese alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that a lengthy consultation about the program would be difficult in Japanese alone. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご希望の言語をお伺いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: May I ask which language you would prefer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ベトナム語です。知人に頼む前に、通訳の相談ができるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 希望言語と知人依頼前の支援照会を申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Vietnamese. Before asking someone I know, I'd like to find out whether I can discuss getting an interpreter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State your preferred language and ask about support before asking an acquaintance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 利用できる支援と日程を確認します。内容はどの制度でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check what support is available and on which dates. Which program is your question about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 子育てに関する相談です。今日は短い質問ではなく、家族の状況も説明したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 制度分野と家族状況を説明したい範囲を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's about support for raising children. Today I have more than a short question; I'd also like to explain my family's situation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Specify the program area and that you also want to explain your family's circumstances. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当部署にも確認して、ご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll also check with the department responsible and let you know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 通訳のある日に相談できれば助かります。なければ別の方法も伺いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通訳日相談を希望し不可時の代案も求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: It would help if I could have the consultation on a day when an interpreter is available. If that isn't possible, I'd also like to ask about other options.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request a consultation on a day with an interpreter and ask for alternatives if that is unavailable. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お急ぎの期限はありますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 案内の期限はまだ読めていません。紙をお見せして、先に期限を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 期限未確認の案内を示して期限から確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I haven't been able to read the deadline in the notice yet. I'd like to show you the paper and check the deadline first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the notice whose deadline you have not checked, and ask to check the deadline first. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: まず案内の期限を確認するご希望を担当へ伝えます。通訳の有無だけで相談を延期しないよう、方法もお確かめください。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll tell the department that you would like to check the notice's deadline first. Please also check the available ways to consult so that the consultation is not postponed solely because of interpreter availability. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 診察で伝えることをまとめられていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you organized what you need to tell the doctor?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 兄の付き添いです。私が書いたメモに、兄が言っていない症状を入れてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 付き添いメモに本人未申告の症状が混入したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm accompanying my older brother. In the notes I wrote, I included a symptom that he never reported.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the accompanying person's notes include a symptom the patient did not report. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご本人が確認できるようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please make sure he can check them himself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いま兄に読んでもらいます。「痛い」は本人の言葉ではなく、私の推測でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 痛みの記述が自分の推測だったと本人確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll have my brother read them now. 'It hurts' wasn't his own wording; it was my assumption.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check with the patient and explain that the description of pain was your own assumption. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 診察では、ご本人の言葉と付き添いの観察を分けて伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: During the consultation, please distinguish his own words from your observations as the person accompanying him.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 本人は「重く感じる」と言っています。その表現を残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人の重さの表現をそのまま残す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: He says it 'feels heavy.' I'll keep that wording.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Retain the patient's exact expression describing heaviness. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 付き添いとして実際に見たことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Is there anything you actually observed while accompanying him?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 歩く速さが普段より遅いことは見ました。原因は分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 観察した歩く速さと原因不明を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I noticed that he walks more slowly than usual. I don't know the cause.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the slower walking you observed from the cause, which you do not know. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それは観察した内容としてお伝えいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can report that as something you observed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 本人の表現を先に、歩き方は私の観察として話します。書き直したメモも渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人の申告と付き添い観察を分けて診察へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll give his own description first, then describe his walking as my observation. I'll also hand over the revised notes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tell the doctor the patient's report and your observations separately. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご本人の言葉と付き添いの観察を分けたメモを、診察でお渡しください。受付からは以上です。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please give the doctor the notes that distinguish his own words from your observations as his companion. That is all from reception. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご相談の内容を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please tell me what you would like to discuss.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 断った後も何度も連絡が来ます。相手の番号を公開すれば止まるかと考えていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 拒否後の反復連絡と番号公開を考えたことを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I keep receiving messages even after saying no. I was wondering whether publishing the person's number would make them stop.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss the repeated contact after your refusal and that you considered publishing the number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 公開や言い争いを始めず、届いた内容について伺わせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please don't publish it or start an argument. Let me ask about the messages you have received.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 公開はしていません。連絡が来た画面と日時を残しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未公開と画面と日時の保存を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't published it. I've saved the screens showing the messages and their dates and times.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not published it and have saved the screens and dates and times. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 直接やり取りした範囲も確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's also check how much direct communication you have had.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一度だけ、連絡をやめてほしいと返しました。それ以後は返していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 停止要求を一回返信し以後未返信と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I replied only once, asking them to stop contacting me. I haven't replied since.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you sent one reply asking them to stop and have not replied since. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 保存した内容を、ご自身が安全に説明できる範囲でお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please show me the saved material to the extent you can safely explain it yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらです。相手の番号を友人に広めず、相談する資料として見せたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 保存内容を相談資料として示し友人への拡散を避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Here it is. I'd like to show it as material for this consultation, without spreading the person's number among my friends.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the saved material for the consultation and avoid spreading it among friends. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が内容を伺い、対応についてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person responsible will hear the details and explain how to respond.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。自分で相手を探しに行かず、届いた事実を順に説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 相手を探しに行かず届いた事実を順序立てて話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I won't go looking for the person myself; I'll explain the contacts I received in order.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain the received contacts in order without going to look for the person. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 届いた連絡の記録を相談担当へお見せください。こちらからは、ご本人が順に説明されることを伝えておきます。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please show the record of the contacts to the consultation staff. I'll tell them that you will explain the facts in order yourself. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらのお荷物ですね。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 宛名を書く面を間違えました。箱を横にしないと読みづらいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 宛名を書いた面の誤りと可読方向を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote the address on the wrong side. It's hard to read unless the box is turned onto its side.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about having written the address on the wrong side and the direction in which it can be read. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 中身を傾けない方がよいお荷物でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is this a parcel whose contents should not be tilted?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。梱包したときの向きを保ちたいです。箱を回してごまかすのは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 内容物の向きを保ち箱回転で済ませたくないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I want to keep it in the orientation it was packed in. I'd rather not just turn the box around to cover up the problem.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to preserve the contents' orientation and avoid resolving it by rotating the box. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 宛名を貼り直せるか、梱包状態と合わせて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check whether the address label can be replaced, along with the condition of the packaging.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。古い宛名が二つ残らないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 旧宛名と新宛名の重複を避けたいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I don't want to leave two address labels, including the old one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request that the old and new address labels not both remain. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 古い表示と新しい表示を混同しないよう整理が必要ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: The old and new labels need to be sorted out so they won't be confused.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 窓口の案内を聞いて直します。上下を示す印だけで扱いが保証されるとは考えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 案内に従い上下印で扱い保証を推測しないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll follow the counter staff's instructions to fix it. I don't assume that an upright marking alone guarantees how it will be handled.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you will follow the instructions and will not assume an upright marking guarantees handling. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 内容と梱包について担当にご説明ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please explain the contents and packaging to the person responsible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 中身と向きを伝えます。対応できない場合は、今日は発送を見合わせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 内容と向きを伝え取扱不可なら発送を見送る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll explain the contents and orientation. If you can't accommodate that, I won't send it today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain the contents and orientation, and postpone sending it if the required handling is unavailable. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 内容物と向き、対応できなければ発送を見合わせるご希望を担当へ引き継ぎます。梱包の案内を聞いてからお決めください。では、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass on the contents, the orientation, and your wish to postpone sending it if we cannot accommodate that. Please decide after hearing the packaging instructions. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通帳の記載についてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about the entries in your bankbook?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この大きな金額を引き出した覚えがありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 残高欄を身に覚えのない引出しと考えたと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I don't remember withdrawing this large amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you mistook the balance column for a withdrawal you do not recognize. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お示しの欄は残高です。お支払いの欄と分かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: The column you're pointing to is the balance. It is separate from the payments column.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 出ていった金額だと思って驚きました。では、この行の引出しはどこですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 残高だと理解して行の引出欄を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I was shocked because I thought it was money that had gone out. Then where is the withdrawal on this line?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that it is the balance and ask where the withdrawal column is on that line. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この行は入金です。取引の区分も併せてご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: This line is a deposit. Please also look at the transaction type.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 入金と残高も混ぜて読んでいました。行ごとに確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 入金と残高の混同を認め行別の照合を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I was confusing deposits and balances too. I'd like to check each line separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Acknowledge confusing deposits and balances and request a line-by-line check. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 直近の行から、内容を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check the details starting with the most recent line.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この支払いだけは見覚えがあります。分からない行は別に印を付けてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 既知の支払と不明な行を分けて記録する方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: This payment is the only one I recognize. May I mark the lines I don't understand separately?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask how to record known payments separately from lines you do not understand. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 記録用のメモに控えていただけます。通帳自体は変更しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can write them down in notes for your records. Please do not alter the bankbook itself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 日付と分からない項目をメモします。残高を支出として足し算するのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 日付と不明項目を別紙へ控え残高の支出合算を止める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll note the dates and the items I don't understand. I'll stop adding up the balances as expenses.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Write the dates and unknown items on a separate sheet and stop counting balances as spending. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 不明な項目はメモのまま担当へお持ちください。残高と支出を分けて読むご相談としておつなぎします。それでは、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please bring your notes on the unclear items to the person responsible. I'll refer you for help reading balances and expenses separately. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの商品、いったんお戻しになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to put this item back for now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 冷凍品ですが、この後まだ長く用事があります。買う順番を間違えました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 冷凍品購入後の長い外出予定に気づいたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's a frozen item, but I still have a long list of errands afterward. I bought things in the wrong order.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you realized you have a lengthy outing planned after buying frozen goods. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだお会計はされていませんね。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。保冷の準備もなく、買って外を回ればよいと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未会計と保冷未準備を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: That's right. I haven't prepared anything to keep it cold either; I thought I could buy it and then go around doing my errands.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not paid and are not prepared to keep the item cold. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 商品の戻し方についてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll explain how to return the item.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。途中まで持ち歩いた品を、黙って別の棚へ置くのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 持歩いた品を黙って棚へ戻さず案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I won't quietly put an item I've carried around onto another shelf.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for instructions rather than silently returning an item you have carried around to a shelf. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらでお預かりして状態を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll take it here and check its condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、お渡しします。外の用事を済ませてから、改めて冷凍品を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 店員へ渡し外の用事後に改めて選ぶと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I'll hand it to you. I'll choose frozen goods again after finishing my errands outside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Hand it to the staff and decide to choose frozen goods after finishing your outside errands. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その際は、お持ち帰りの方法もお考えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also consider how you will take them home when you do.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、直接帰れるときに買います。今日は常温の商品だけ会計します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 直接帰宅できる時に購入し本日は常温品だけ会計する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, I'll buy them when I can go straight home. Today I'll only pay for room-temperature goods.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to buy frozen goods when you can go directly home and pay only for room-temperature goods today. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらをお預かりします。またご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll take this item. Please visit us again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらで何かお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for something here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 皆さんが集まっているので、行事の受付かと思って来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 集まりを行事受付と勘違いして来たと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I saw everyone gathered here and came over thinking this was registration for an event.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you came because you mistook the gathering for event registration. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今は清掃活動をしています。催しの受付ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: We're doing a cleanup activity now. This isn't event registration.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうでしたか。道具があれば、私も手伝えるでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 清掃活動だと知り手伝い参加を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I see. If there are tools available, could I help too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Having learned it is a cleanup activity, ask to join and help. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 参加できるか、担当者に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll ask the person responsible whether you can participate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 確認してからにします。ごみ袋を勝手に持って歩くところでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 道具を無断で使わず参加確認を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll wait until that's confirmed. I was just about to take a garbage bag and walk around without asking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Wait for permission to participate without using equipment without authorization. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: どのくらいお時間がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: How much time do you have?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 少しだけです。途中で抜けるので、それでも参加してよいか伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 短時間で途中退出する条件を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Only a little. I'll need to leave partway through, so please ask whether I can still take part.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you only have a short time and will leave before the end. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 短い時間ということも、担当へお知らせします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll also tell the person responsible that you only have a short time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。参加できなければ、作業の邪魔をしない場所へ移ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 参加不可なら作業の妨げにならない場所へ移る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. If I can't participate, I'll move somewhere that won't get in the way of the work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: If participation is unavailable, move to a place where you will not obstruct the work. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 途中で抜けるご希望を清掃の担当へ確認します。返事があるまでは作業に入らずお待ちください。では、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll ask the cleanup organizer about your wish to leave partway through. Please wait without starting work until we have a reply. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 券についてのご質問でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about your ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この先の駅へも行く予定でしたが、券には手前の駅までと書かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 券の終点より先へ行く予定を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was planning to go to a station farther along too, but the ticket says it only goes as far as a nearer station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about your plan to travel beyond the destination on the ticket. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 購入時の目的地とは違う予定になったのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have your plans changed from the destination you chose when you bought it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。途中で友人に会って、その後も同じ券で行けると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人訪問後も同券で行けると思った経緯を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I thought I could meet a friend on the way and then keep going with the same ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain why you thought you could continue on the same ticket after visiting your friend. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この券で利用できる区間と、次の移動を分けて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the section covered by this ticket separately from your next journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 追加の区間を使う前に、必要な手続きを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 区間外利用前の必要手続きを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please tell me what procedures I need before traveling on the additional section.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about the necessary procedures before traveling beyond the covered section. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 券の種類と目的地を確認してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check your ticket type and destination and explain.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 目的地はこのメモの駅です。区間外へ先に乗ってから考えるのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 最終目的地を示し先乗りを避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: My destination is the station on this note. I won't board beyond the covered section first and think about it afterward.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show your final destination and avoid boarding first beyond the covered section. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 現在の券を使う部分もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also check the part where you will use your current ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まず手前の駅までの券を確認し、その先の移動は別に手続きを相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 既存券区間と以後の手続きを分けて確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll first check the ticket to the nearer station, then ask separately about the procedures for traveling farther.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the current ticket's covered section separately from the procedures for the onward journey. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 今の券と区間外のご相談を分けて、乗車券の窓口へおつなぎします。それでは、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll refer you to the ticket counter for separate questions about your current ticket and travel beyond its section. Have a safe trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 本日のお手続きはお客様の分でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are today's procedures for you yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私と妻の分です。ただ、妻にはまだ内容を説明していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 妻への説明前に二人分の手続きを希望したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: For my wife and me. However, I haven't explained the details to my wife yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you requested procedures for both of you before explaining them to your wife. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 必要な確認は手続きごとに異なります。まず内容を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: The necessary checks vary by procedure. First, please tell me what it involves.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この届出です。私がよいと思えば二人分進められると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 届出内容と自分の判断で進められると思った点を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's this notification. I thought I could proceed for both of us if I considered it a good idea.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the notification and explain that you thought your own judgment was enough to proceed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 奥様のご意思や必要な書類について、担当に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's ask the person responsible about your wife's wishes and the required documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、妻の分は今日は進めず、説明を聞いて持ち帰りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 妻の申請を保留し説明だけ持ち帰ると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I won't proceed with my wife's part today. I'd like to hear the explanation and take it home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide to put your wife's application on hold and take home only the explanation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自身の分も、内容を理解してからお決めください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please decide about your own part too only after understanding the details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。変更される点を紙で確認して、妻にも同じ説明を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 変更点を文書で確認し妻へ同じ説明を共有する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I'll check the changes in writing and share the same explanation with my wife.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the changes in writing and share the same explanation with your wife. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご不明な点は、その場でお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please ask about anything you don't understand while you are here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この届出をしない場合にどうなるかも伺います。夫婦で相談してから決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未申請の場合も聞き夫婦で相談後に決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll also ask what happens if we don't submit this notification. We'll decide after discussing it as a couple.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask about not submitting the notification and decide after discussing it with your spouse. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご家族へ持ち帰る説明と、届出をしない場合の扱いは担当窓口でお確かめください。ご相談ありがとうございました。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check with the relevant counter about the explanation to take home to your family and what happens if you do not submit the notification. Thank you for consulting us. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 次回のご案内をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please check the information about your next visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この日は診察ですか。職場には診察のため休むと伝えました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 結果受取日を診察日として休暇連絡したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Is that day a medical consultation? I told my workplace I'd take time off for a consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you told work you would take time off for a consultation on what is actually a results collection day. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 案内には結果の受取りとあります。診察予約があるかも確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: The notice says collection of results. Let's also check whether you have a consultation appointment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 受取日なら必ず診察があると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受取と診察を一体だと考えた誤りを認める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought there would always be a consultation on the day results are collected.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge your mistaken assumption that collecting results always includes a consultation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 結果の説明を受ける予定について、担当に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check with the person responsible about plans for explaining the results.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。受け取るだけなのか、説明を聞くのかを知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 単なる受取と医療説明の有無を区別して尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I'd like to know whether I'll only collect them or also hear an explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask separately whether you will only collect the results or receive a medical explanation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認前に、お休みの予定を変えずお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please wait without changing your time-off plans until we have checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。職場へは、案内を確認中だと伝えるだけにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 確定前に休暇を変えず確認中と職場へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I'll only tell my workplace that I'm checking the information.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Keep your leave unchanged until confirmed and tell work that you are checking. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご本人以外の受取りをご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Would you like someone other than yourself to collect them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: いいえ、私が来ます。家族に代理で頼めると勝手には考えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人来院を示し代理受取を前提にしない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: No, I'll come myself. I'm not assuming I can ask a family member to collect them on my behalf.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: State that you will come yourself and do not assume collection by a representative is allowed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご本人が来られるご希望を添えて、結果受取りと診察の予定を担当へ確認します。受付での確認は以上です。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll tell the person responsible that you intend to come yourself and check the arrangements for collecting results and a consultation. That is all we need to check at reception. Goodbye.
